name: spliit-mcp-cloudflare
description: Unofficial, secure, stateful Spliit MCP server for Cloudflare Workers

scripts.check: npm run types:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run deploy:dry-run && npm run check:startup

MCP_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Generate a unique bearer token with at least 32 random characters. Save it in your password manager; MCP clients need the same value.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Generate a second unique bearer token for the protected group setup UI. It must differ from MCP_AUTH_TOKEN.

DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Generate exactly 32 random bytes as 64 hexadecimal characters. This encrypts group credentials and write drafts inside the Durable Object.

SPLIIT_GROUPS_JSON.description: Import-only migration secret. Existing installs keep their current JSON; new installs use [] and add groups at /setup after deployment.
